run.executedVia: Playwright driving Lightning Experience. Every screen assertion is cross-checked against the ServiceNow record over cnit and the Salesforce record over the sf CLI. No case in this file writes to either platform.

case.title: A count mismatch raises a warning

steps.text: Open the evidence panel on CAFT0001052.

rows.warning: 0 in Salesforce, 1 in ServiceNow. Re-upload the missing file to send it to the system of record.

observations: The ServiceNow attachment is encryption-config.txt, uploaded straight to ServiceNow by verify_api.sh, so it never reached Salesforce. That is not a compliance failure, which is why the wording matters more than the fact of the warning.

Finding — the advice is backwards for this mismatch. cafEvidence.mismatchLabel is unconditional: it always says "Re-upload the missing file to send it to the system of record", which is correct only when Salesforce holds more than ServiceNow, i.e. a push failed. Here ServiceNow holds more (1 against 0), so the system of record already has the file and following the advice would create a third ServiceNow attachment rather than repair anything. This is the only mismatch state present on the instance today, so it is the one a user will actually meet. The label needs to branch on which side is short.
expected: CAFT0001052 carries 0 Salesforce files against 1 ServiceNow attachment.
The panel shows a warning, and it reads as informative rather than alarming.
actual: Salesforce 0 file(s) against ServiceNow 1 attachment(s) — mismatch present: true
Warning shown: 0 in Salesforce, 1 in ServiceNow. Re-upload the missing file to send it to the system of record.
Wording judged informative: "0 in Salesforce, 1 in ServiceNow. Re-upload the missing file to send it to the system of record."
case.verdictReason: Mismatch detected and surfaced informatively: "0 in Salesforce, 1 in ServiceNow. Re-upload the missing file to send it to the system of record.". The case's stated expectation is met — but see the observation on the remediation advice, which is wrong for this direction of mismatch and should be raised separately.
